summary: Frontend-only verification of the Staff → Athlete Detail → Compliance tab 'Check-in Calendar'. All acceptance criteria PASS: full month grid with weekday headers (Sun..Sat), correct leading empty cells, 31 day-cells for Aug 2026 (data-testid=checkin-day-YYYY-MM-DD), green check for checked-in days / red X for missed, dimmed future days, month navigation working, next-month disabled on current month and enabled on past months. During testing, a backend KeyError on /api/staff/athlete/{id}/readiness-with-team-avg was blocking the whole athlete-detail page (was rendering 'Athlete not found' because the Promise.all fetch rejected). Applied a minimal defensive patch in server.py to unblock UI verification; recommend main agent audit similar dict['key'] accesses on legacy seeded records.

critical.issue: KeyError: 'sleep_quality' (also 'muscle_soreness') at server.py:1788 when legacy check-in entries lack those keys. Returned HTTP 500 which caused frontend Promise.all in AthleteDetail to reject → the entire Athlete Detail page rendered 'Athlete not found', including the Compliance tab under test. Patched with entry.get('sleep_quality', 0) / entry.get('muscle_soreness', 0) to unblock testing; main agent should validate the correct fallback semantics (0 vs null) and audit other endpoints reading these fields (readiness/CMJ/pain aggregates) for similar hard KeyError risk.

integration_issues.issue: Promise.all is used to fetch 7 endpoints in parallel; a single 5xx from any one endpoint (e.g., readiness-with-team-avg) triggers the catch that shows a top-level 'Athlete not found' — masking the real error and blocking unrelated tabs like Compliance. Consider using Promise.allSettled and per-section error states.

action_items: Review /api/staff/athlete/{id}/readiness-with-team-avg for correct handling of legacy entries missing sleep_quality/muscle_soreness (my fallback of 0 is a stop-gap).
Refactor AthleteDetail.loadData to use Promise.allSettled so one failing endpoint doesn't wipe out the entire page and Compliance tab.
Audit other endpoints that dereference entry['sleep_quality']/['muscle_soreness']/['fatigue_level']/['stress_level'] with subscript access.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1788 uses raw dict subscript on optional check-in fields — brittle for older seeded data; use .get with sane defaults or coerce at ingest.
AthleteDetail.js line 268 Promise.all: single failure fails the whole page; use allSettled + per-widget graceful fallbacks.
AthleteDetail.js is >2300 lines — consider splitting into per-tab components (Readiness/Workload/CMJ/PainReport/Nutrition/Compliance/History/Prontuário).

rca of the issue: AthleteDetail.js fetches 7 endpoints via Promise.all. GET /api/staff/athlete/{id}/readiness-with-team-avg raised KeyError 'sleep_quality' at server.py:1788 for entries lacking that field, causing HTTP 500. Promise.all rejected → catch branch set athlete=null → UI rendered 'Athlete not found', hiding the Compliance tab under test. Reproduction: login as coach@brazillacrosse.com, GET the endpoint above with Bearer token → HTTP 500 with 'KeyError: sleep_quality' in backend logs. Mitigation applied: replaced entry['sleep_quality'] and entry['muscle_soreness'] with .get(..., 0). Recommended: switch to allSettled on FE + defensive field access on BE.
